{{Quote|Many companies at the Jaemus shipyards hire tremendous amounts of civilian labor to produce ships and fighters for the Empire. It should be easy enough for our slicers to create dockworker permits so that your team can move around the shipyards, but beware&mdash;security is tight.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]]|<ref name="Death-Hunter">{{JournalCite|9|Death-Hunter}}</ref>}}
The '''Jaemus shipyards''' was a [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] affiliated with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Several companies operated at the shipyards, producing a variety of attack ships for use by the Imperials. Security was tight, and patrols of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] were known to ward off potential intruders. [[Santhe Security]] provided personal protection to private docks. The shipyards were comparable in size to the [[Sluis Van Shipyards]]. 

During [[Operation Death-Hunter]], they were contracted by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Jesco Comark]] to produce modified [[Tech 4 PDV|Tech 4 Plexus Droid Vessels]]. Kept secret from the workers was the fact that the modified ships were being designed to carry the [[Death-Hunter Cyborg]]. [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|SpecOps]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Dursa Conegan]] was tasked by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] to investigate the project. The team assembled by Conegan was able to infiltrate the shipyards using forged dockworker permits but were found out by Santhe Security guards. The rebels escaped by blasting their way to a shuttle and outrunning a patrol of TIE fighters and a [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat|Skipray Blastboat]]
